0022600158.text: The Cavaliers (4-2, 3-0 at home, on a one-game win streak) are second in the Central, one game back, and fourth in the East, while the Thunder (4-2, 1-2 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) are second in the Northwest, half a game back, and fifth in the West. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Cleveland lost both games to Oklahoma City in 2025-26, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
